items.reason: Enactment of the Coast Guard Law authorising use of weapons is a new legal instrument; 2020's record has only its draft (ev-8c1dd52d0b, undecided). If the coder makes the 2020 draft the move, this becomes its continuation instead.

Massing about 220 militia-crewed vessels at Whitsun Reef has nothing comparable in the 2020 candidates (judged against undecided CN-2016-2020 candidates); a new method of presence in the Philippine EEZ.
Embassy and spokesman statements defending the Whitsun Reef massing; part of the same intensification as ev-1276f0fc14.

CCG and navy craft chasing a Philippine boat off Second Thomas Shoal belongs with the 2021 access-denial move led by ev-382f3fde7c; nothing comparable at Second Thomas in the 2020 candidates. The coder may treat it as separate.

Routine annual summer fishing moratorium, already present in 2020 (prev-run candidate ev-2de6fa208c); same level. [Re-pointed 2026-11-20: ev-2de6fa208c has since been decided; its chain ends at CN201703.]

Mass PLAAF transport formation (16 aircraft) into Malaysia's maritime-zone airspace near Luconia Shoals; the 2020 candidates show nothing comparable in the air against Malaysia (2020's Malaysian case ev-c966892c8f was a sea survey).

CCG cutters shadowing Malaysian energy work at Kasawari repeat the 2020 practice at the West Capella (prev-run candidate ev-c966892c8f) at a similar level. [Re-pointed 2026-11-20: ev-c966892c8f has since been decided; its chain ends at CN202002.]

Months-long CCG patrol at Indonesia's Tuna-block rig with a demand to stop drilling: pressure on Indonesian resource activity, against 2020's Natuna fishing-escort case (ev-3252bb0728) which did not target drilling.

PLA statement on expelling USS Benfold from 'Xisha territorial waters' repeats the 2020 practice of announcing expulsions of US FONOPs (prev-run candidate ev-f89607f096). [Re-pointed 2026-11-20: ev-f89607f096 has since been decided; its chain ends at CN201806.]

Award-anniversary rejection repeats the 2020 verbal rejections of the award (prev-run candidate ev-7cbb37617c); same level. [Re-pointed 2026-11-20: ev-7cbb37617c has since been decided; its chain ends at CN201904.]

Exercise between Hainan and the Paracels repeats the 2020 Paracel exercises (prev-run candidate ev-32d0b4c61f) at the same level. [Re-pointed 2026-11-20: ev-32d0b4c61f has since been decided; its chain ends at CN201002.]
Haiyang Dizhi 10 survey on Indonesia's shelf, escorted by the same CCG ship (6305) patrolling the Tuna rig; part of the 2021 pressure on Indonesia led by ev-1373ca0027.

New mandatory reporting rule for foreign vessels entering claimed territorial seas under the revised Maritime Traffic Safety Law; nothing comparable in the 2020 candidates. Coder may instead merge it with the Coast Guard Law move ev-f90f3e7db5 as one legislative step.

Y-20 troop-rotation flights at Spratly airfields are garrison logistics; 2020's record has fighters/bombers at Woody Island (ev-60f35ac039) but nothing on Spratly air operations. Settle by whether PLA aircraft already operated from the Spratly bases in 2020; a new aircraft type alone is not a new method.

Da Yang Hao survey on Malaysia's shelf near the West Capella repeats the 2020 Haiyang Dizhi 8 survey (undecided ev-c966892c8f); it also entered Bruneian and Philippine EEZs, which could make it a scope move — the coder should weigh that extension.
First water-cannoning of a Second Thomas resupply mission: a new method of denying access, with nothing comparable at Second Thomas in the 2020 candidates.
Foreign Ministry defence of the 16 November water cannoning at Ren'ai Jiao; part of the move led by ev-382f3fde7c.

Restatement of the 'four sha' claim with maritime zones, answering LIS 150; a verbal maintenance of the standing claim. 2021 candidates have only routine statements (ev-6193c612b5); settle by whether the coder sees the formal zone claim as new — likely reject.

CCG close manoeuvring against a PCG patrol ship at Scarborough: no Scarborough coercion in the 2021 candidates (2021 coercion was at Second Thomas, ev-382f3fde7c), so the coercive practice extends to Scarborough. The PCG's 'fourth such incident' suggests earlier ones not in the record — check.
CCG 5203 tailing the joint Philippine-Taiwanese survey in the Philippine EEZ; same intensification as ev-e74eccab57 (pressure on surveys in the Philippine EEZ).
Spokesman's claim to jurisdiction at Huangyan Dao telling Philippine ships not to interfere with CCG enforcement; part of the Scarborough move led by ev-dec0e0289e.

CCG tailing of a licensed seismic survey in SC 75, which was then suspended: 2021 pressure on resource activity was against Malaysia and Indonesia (ev-37191fb226, ev-1373ca0027) — this extends it to the Philippine EEZ.
Pursuing and turning back Philippine government vessels at Second Thomas continues 2021's access denial (ev-382f3fde7c) at no higher level (no water cannon).
Routine annual fishing moratorium, present in 2021 (ev-2c958d1eb0); same level.
Drill near Woody Island repeats 2021's Paracel exercise (ev-54ad34c9bf) at the same level.
Tailing DA BFAR away from Second Thomas continues 2021's access denial (ev-382f3fde7c) at the same or lower level.
Undated July drills near the Paracels repeat 2021's practice (ev-54ad34c9bf); low-precision source.
Routine award-anniversary rejection, present in 2021 (ev-6193c612b5).
Repeat of the July 2021 USS Benfold expulsion statement (ev-01cc801ab5).
Obstruction of an August resupply to Second Thomas continues 2021's access denial (ev-382f3fde7c); month-only, single later source.
CCG patrols extended through Vietnam's Nam Con Son concessions, which AMTI calls a break from past behaviour; 2021 candidates have no CCG patrols of Vietnamese energy fields.
Blocking a Philippine Navy team and forcibly taking the towed rocket debris off Pag-asa is a new method (forcible seizure from a navy crew); nothing comparable in the 2021 candidates.
CCG 5901 patrol near the Tuna block continues 2021's CCG presence at Tuna (ev-1373ca0027) at presence level; the coder may weigh the pass by Vietnam's Chim Sao field as scope.

Military-grade laser against a PCG ship at Second Thomas is a new method; 2022's Second Thomas record is pursuit and tailing only (ev-bd42678121, ev-6f5590a8b2). Leads the 2023 Second Thomas escalation (laser, water cannon back, first collisions); the coder may split these.
CCG 5901 shadowing Kasawari construction at Luconia: no Malaysian case in the 2022 candidates, so the practice last seen in 2021 (ev-37191fb226) is new again.

CCG patrol through Nam Con Son continues the 2022 route (ev-b123c9c360, undecided); the dangerous close-range encounter with Kiem Ngu 278 may be a change of method — settle by whether it was deliberate interference or a one-off reaction.
Near-collision interception of PCG boats off Second Thomas; part of the 2023 Second Thomas move led by ev-699350172b (alone it would be 2022-level blocking).
Routine annual fishing ban, present in 2022 (ev-eea42297cc).
Escorted Xiang Yang Hong 10 survey in Vietnam's EEZ near gas blocks; the 2022 candidates have no survey against Vietnam, so the method is new against last year.
Blocking PCG ships at Second Thomas with an enforcement justification; part of the 2023 Second Thomas move led by ev-699350172b.
Routine award-anniversary rejection, present in 2022 (ev-acc952043f).
New ~600 m airstrip on Triton Island: new construction, nothing comparable in the 2022 candidates.
Water cannon at Second Thomas reappears (absent in 2022 candidates); part of the 2023 Second Thomas move led by ev-699350172b.
Formal remarks demanding the Sierra Madre be towed away; declarative accompaniment of the 2023 Second Thomas move ev-699350172b.

Annual standard-map edition showing the ten-dash line; not in the 2022 candidates but the line has appeared on official maps since 2013. Settle by whether the 2023 edition changed anything — likely reject as routine.
Floating barrier across the Scarborough lagoon entrance is a new method of denial; 2022's Scarborough record is close manoeuvring (ev-dec0e0289e).
Formal legal statement on Ren'ai Jiao; declarative accompaniment of the 2023 Second Thomas move ev-699350172b. Its archipelagic argument was already in the 2022 'four sha' statement (ev-d5eaf16937).
A PLAN warship trying to cut across a Philippine Navy resupply ship near Thitu: navy-on-navy interference not seen in the 2022 candidates (2022 Thitu case ev-9bdb6b30ce was the CCG).
First collisions with a resupply boat and PCG ship at Second Thomas; part of the 2023 Second Thomas move led by ev-699350172b (the coder may make the ramming its own move).
Water cannon on M/L Kalayaan at Second Thomas; part of the 2023 Second Thomas move led by ev-699350172b.

Renewed massing at Whitsun Reef; absent from 2022 candidates but seen in 2021 (ev-1276f0fc14). Settle by whether the militia presence at Union Banks continued through 2022 (then continuation) or lapsed (then new again).
Six-point claim statement disclosing ~100 démarches; a verbal restatement like 2022's ev-d5eaf16937. Likely reject as maintenance unless the coder counts the démarches as a frequency increase.
First water cannon at Scarborough, with the barrier again; part of the 2023 Scarborough move led by ev-465b728e8c.
Water cannon disabling M/L Kalayaan and ramming at Second Thomas; part of the 2023 Second Thomas move led by ev-699350172b.

AMTI: CCG ship-days at key locations rose to 1,939 from 1,652 in 2023, Vanguard Bank days to 354 from 221. The 2023 candidates have no aggregate to compare; the numbers come from the same AMTI series. Check the counterfactual (more Philippine presence to react to).
Warning Philippine personnel off Scarborough continues 2023's Scarborough denial (ev-465b728e8c) at a lower level.

Diplomatic note demanding Malaysia stop exploring at Luconia; date uncertain (February or August 2024). Settle by the date and whether similar notes went in 2023 alongside the CCG shadowing (ev-4a57a94e66); possibly a novelty against Malaysia.
Blocking a BFAR ship at Scarborough continues 2023's Scarborough denial (ev-465b728e8c, ev-d6fefaed7b) at the same level.
Water cannon and collisions at Second Thomas continue 2023's methods (ev-699350172b group); worse injuries are not a new method.
Water cannon at Second Thomas continues 2023's practice (ev-699350172b group).
Water cannon at Scarborough continues 2023's (ev-d6fefaed7b).
Routine annual fishing ban, present in 2023 (ev-3fa9454dd6).
CCG Order No. 3 lets the CCG detain foreigners up to 60 days in claimed waters, a new legal enforcement power; nothing comparable in the 2023 candidates.
Ramming a medevac boat at Second Thomas continues 2023's collisions (ev-8ef41aeb60).
Armed CCG boarding of Philippine Navy boats and seizure of rifles at Second Thomas is a new method (force), beyond 2023's water cannon and ramming (ev-699350172b group).

Rejection of the Philippine CLCS submission is a reactive verbal protest; China would have protested any submission (cf. 2009), so likely reject as maintenance. Nothing comparable in 2023 only because there was nothing to react to.
Routine award-anniversary rejection, present in 2023 (ev-200ad90dcf).
Protest at Vietnam's CLCS submission is reactive maintenance, as for ev-1b85632aee; likely reject.
PLAAF aircraft dropping flares in front of a Philippine Air Force patrol plane over Scarborough is a new method (air interference); no air interceptions in the 2023 candidates.
Ramming PCG vessels at Sabina Shoal: 2023 rammings were at Second Thomas (ev-8ef41aeb60), so the practice extends to Sabina. Leads the Sabina 2024 group.
Ramming and water cannon on BRP Datu Sanday at Sabina; part of the Sabina move led by ev-3c31156a99.
Triple ramming of BRP Teresa Magbanua at Sabina; part of the Sabina move led by ev-3c31156a99.
Boarding and beating Vietnamese fishermen with iron bars in the Paracels; the 2023 candidates have no violence against Vietnamese fishers, so the method is new.

Militia sideswipe near Sandy Cay; 2023's Thitu-area record is a PLAN bow-crossing (ev-09eae551bb) and démarches over Sandy Cay (ev-5989fa2cfd). Settle by whether this was a new location/method or same-level harassment around Pag-asa.
CCG 5402 disrupting Pertamina's seismic survey in the North Natuna Sea: no Indonesian case in the 2023 candidates, and disruption goes beyond the 2021–22 presence at Tuna (ev-1373ca0027).
Intensified CCG 'management and control' patrols in the claimed territorial waters off Huangyan Dao; enforcement of the baselines move led by ev-d3525fac40.
Statement and summons rejecting the Philippine Maritime Zones Act; part of the November 2024 Huangyan Dao response led by ev-d3525fac40.
Territorial-sea baselines around Huangyan Dao are new (Chubb codes such baselines coercive); nothing comparable in the 2023 candidates.
PLA combat-readiness patrol in Huangyan's claimed territorial sea three days after the baselines; part of the move led by ev-d3525fac40.
Water cannon and sideswipe near Scarborough continue 2023's practice (ev-d6fefaed7b).
CCG ship-days at six locations rose to 2,183 from 1,939 (2024, ev-9a3bba41b6), with Scarborough more than doubling to 1,099 and Sabina nearly tripling to 405: a stated frequency increase.
CCG/MSA patrols around Pratas on 60 days in 2025 against 25 in 2024, with entry into Pratas's territorial waters; nothing on Pratas in the 2024 candidates.
CCG 5901 loitering 54 nm off Zambales inside the Philippine EEZ, closer to Luzon than the 2024 Scarborough patrols (ev-9a3bba41b6): a geographic extension.
PLAN helicopter's dangerous manoeuvre against a BFAR aircraft over Scarborough continues 2024's air interference (ev-9909171925).
Verbal objection to Vietnam's Barque Canada Reef reclamation; reactive maintenance of the claim with no 2024 equivalent only because there was less to react to. Likely reject.
CCG personnel landing on Sandy Cay and displaying the flag is a new method; 2024's Sandy Cay record is a militia sideswipe at sea (ev-770c9b02a4).
Routine annual fishing ban, present in 2024 (ev-820f48d4c0).
First water cannon at the Pag-asa Cays (Sandy Cay); 2024 water cannon was at Second Thomas, Scarborough and Sabina, so the practice extends to the Pag-asa area.
Routine award-anniversary rejection, present in 2024 (ev-40f596df45).
High-speed pursuit and water cannon at Scarborough continue 2024's practice (ev-7579c5b956, undecided); the joint CCG–PLAN pursuit may be a change of method — the coder should weigh it.
Verbal warning of 'necessary measures' against Vietnamese construction; reactive restatement like ev-f876a8fea6. Likely reject unless the warning is read as a new threat.

State Council approval of a Huangyan Dao national nature reserve is a new kind of administrative act at Scarborough; nothing comparable in the 2024 candidates (the baselines ev-d3525fac40 are a different instrument).
Water cannon with injury at Scarborough continues 2024's practice (ev-6f4b956eeb, ev-7579c5b956).
A PLAN radio threat of live fire to clear PCG ships and fishing boats from a declared zone off Zambales; the PCG calls it the first such threat, nothing comparable in 2024.
Strengthened CCG and PLA patrols at Huangyan Dao from October; evidence of the Scarborough presence increase in the move led by ev-f2a7a0758f (2024's equivalent was ev-6181c34bfc).
Water cannon and ramming near Pag-asa Island; part of the Pag-asa-area move led by ev-49abfad6c8.
First radio challenge invoking the new Huangyan nature reserve; enforcement of the reserve move led by ev-77b669121f.
Large-scale reclamation at Antelope Reef, the first major Chinese island-building in about a decade; nothing comparable in the 2024 candidates.

Water cannon against Filipino fishing boats at Sabina continues 2024's Sabina coercion (ev-3c31156a99 group, undecided); the turn to civilian fishermen may or may not be a change of method — coder to decide.

Early-2026 CCG incursions and a reported drone entry at Pratas follow 2025's increase (ev-ff965c459e, undecided). Partial-year data; settle by the full-year count and confirmation of the drone airspace entry, which would be a novelty.
AMTI: 933 CCG ship-days at Scarborough in January–June 2026 (156 a month) against 90 a month a year earlier and 1,099 for all of 2025 (ev-f2a7a0758f): a stated frequency increase.
PLAN and CCG blocking a fishing boat at Scarborough continues 2025's joint CCG–PLAN harassment there (ev-a02e15898c).
Suspected jamming of a PCG aircraft's Starlink link, which the PCG says is a first; a new method beyond the 2025 air interference (ev-f606c686c3). The radio challenges alone would be continuation.
Driving Filipino fishermen from Scarborough continues 2025's coercion there (ev-17012136bd).
Verbal defence of the Paracels reclamation; reactive maintenance like 2025's ev-f876a8fea6. Likely reject.
Routine annual fishing ban, present in 2025 (ev-2a9bb65441).
Unauthorised marine research by Xiang Yang Hong 33 at Iroquois Reef in the Philippine EEZ; the 2025 candidates have no Chinese research survey in another claimant's EEZ.
A floating platform with buoys and an antenna emplaced inside the Scarborough lagoon is a new method of presence; nothing comparable in the 2025 candidates.
Award-anniversary rejection, present in 2025 (ev-0adeee10d3), this year as a formal statement: a change of form, not of method.

Assault with a baton during an attempted approach to the Sierra Madre: no Second Thomas coercion in the 2025 candidates, so force there (last seen 2024, ev-a620e73798) is new again. Leads the 2026 Second Thomas group.
Water cannon at Scarborough continues 2025's practice (ev-17012136bd).
Second day of water cannon at Scarborough; continues 2025's practice (ev-17012136bd).
Statement rejecting the Philippine baselines around Huangyan Dao; reactive verbal restatement. Likely reject as maintenance unless the coder groups it with a new Scarborough move.

Management measures banning entry and fishing in the Huangyan reserve implement the 2025 reserve (ev-77b669121f, undecided). Settle whether this is the same arrangement still in force (continuation) or a new legal layer (novelty).
PLA naval-air exercise in Huangyan's claimed territorial sea continues 2025's combat-readiness patrols there (ev-9a8ff07998).
Ramming a BFAR vessel near Abad Santos Shoal, 54 nm off Palawan: farther than the 2025 flashpoints (Scarborough, Sabina, Pag-asa), a geographic extension.
PLAN threat of 'compulsory measures' that aborted a Second Thomas resupply; part of the 2026 Second Thomas move led by ev-fbbb9d1be4.
Water cannon and obstruction of a medevac at Second Thomas; part of the 2026 Second Thomas move led by ev-fbbb9d1be4.
